title: Petition of Quickway Transportation, Inc. of West Boylston, Massachusetts, requesting the Department of Public Utilities to issue a 120-day temporary license, pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, §5, as amended, authorizing the operation of motor vehicles for hire over public ways in the Towns of Framingham and Natick, the City of Boston, and public ways under the jurisdiction of the Massachusetts Turnpike Authority, to provide transportation between Framingham and Logan International Airport under a contract with the Massachusetts Port Authority.
